department: Department of Astronomy and Steward Observatory

deadline.value: Apply by December 3, 2026 (international and domestic). Fee-waiver requests are due November 19, 2026.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply is December 3rd, 2026.

also.quote: Requests must be received no later than November 19th, 2026.

fee_waiver.value: Need-based fee waivers for financial hardship, requested by email to the program coordinator before November 19, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: The fee waiver program is intended for cases of financial hardship

gre_general.value: The program is not accepting GRE scores in the 2026-27 season.
gre_general.quote: The Astronomy program is not accepting GRE scores (general or physics) for the 2026-2027 application season.

gre_subject.value: The program is not accepting GRE Physics scores in the 2026-27 season.
gre_subject.quote: The Astronomy program is not accepting GRE scores (general or physics) for the 2026-2027 application season.

supervisor.value: An admissions committee reviews applications; you contact potential supervisors after admission.
supervisor.quote: applications are reviewed not by the potential advisor of a student, but by an admissions committee. | Students are encouraged to reach out to potential supervisors after admission

funding.value: All admitted students receive a stipend, with tuition and health benefits covered by the department.
funding.quote: All students admitted to our graduate program are provided a stipend. Tuition and health benefits are also covered by the department.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (BA, BS, BE) is enough; a three-year degree question is answered as at least a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Students must have at least a Bachelor’s degree (BA, BS, BE, BsENG).

notes: PhD only; no master's program. Planetary Sciences (LPL) is a separate PhD not covered here.
